answer: Each agent locks a slashable bond and registers one TCG opal self-encrypting drive, binding its serial and the host's measured boot kernel to a single pubkey. Serials appear in a public orchard, so a reused volume is obvious. Challenge rounds demand a fresh remote attestation of that same kernel and volume before a short deadline. A late attestation, a kernel hash that diverges from enrollment, or two keys tied to one serial slashes every linked deposit. Operating N identities requires N distinct opal drives, N attestable hosts, and N bonds at risk; keypairs that reuse a volume add no weight.
